summary: Pi Zero 2 W tray with two rear USB cuts and 4 lid screws. Missing fan, OLED window, encoder, vents, snap latches. Gates G3, G4, G5 fail. Judged without claude-context (server failed to connect).

defects.what: no fan, no fan posts, no intake/exhaust paths, no side vents; rays through both long walls at z=-4.6,-0.7,3.1 hit only the solid wall
defects.expected: fan on 32 mm pitch above Pi, 4 posts, vents >=300 mm2 each above/below mid-plane

defects.where: front wall (-Y) and front panel, views/model_front.png
defects.what: no OLED window, no 7.3-7.5 mm encoder hole
defects.expected: window for 25x14 viewing area, encoder hole d7.4

defects.what: lid held by 4 M3 bosses+screws (boss_1..4, lid_lip), no snap hooks

defects.where: rear +Y wall, two port cuts, views/model_iso.png
defects.what: two openings present; plug clearance/oversize not verified against plug envelopes
